dict.string: Every 5 minutes: is RuvNet Brain search actually working? Runs scripts/search-canary.mjs (cheap checks every run, about half a second of CPU; a real search through a fresh copy of the installed plugin server hourly and whenever a cheap check fails). Two failing runs in a row page "SERIOUS ALERT: RuvNet Brain search down" (ntfy topic from ~/.cache/ruvnet-brain/ntfy-topic; e-mail through ntfy when ~/.cache/ruvnet-brain/ntfy-token holds an account token), repeated at most hourly, one recovery notice, one "search OK" heartbeat a day. Written after the 2026-11-16 outage, when a 3:31 a.m. Homebrew upgrade broke search for hours and nobody was told. Wrapped in job-heartbeat.sh (receipt + page if the canary itself fails).
